purpose: Bounded, evidence-first engineering state for Aether agent work.

current_hypotheses.text: Aether needs a repository-native state contract before autonomous planning and self-verification can be expanded.

current_tasks.text: Implement a bounded repository-native autonomy protocol without assuming unavailable platform capabilities.
Establish a repository-native communication protocol linking Creator/Architect, Agent/Aether, and User/External through durable channels and bounded state events.

verification.hardware_evidence: must remain distinct from QEMU/CI evidence

operating_rules: inspect -> decide -> change -> commit -> verify -> CI -> inspect evidence -> continue
one controlled logical change per commit
never treat documentation or model reasoning as runtime evidence
stop when required evidence or human authorization is missing
do not create unbounded self-propagating execution
next_step: Use the recorded QEMU evidence as the baseline and choose the next single controlled validation.

last_experience.conclusion: QEMU boot reached Aether Desktop without PANIC; evidence is valid for kernel/ISO/QEMU startup but does not establish AH532 hardware behavior or Ring3 execution.
observations: Aether Desktop initialization observed in QEMU serial output.
No Ring3 execution evidence observed; QEMU validation remains pre-Ring3.
QEMU has no Intel Gen6 display controller; this is virtual-hardware evidence, not AH532 evidence.
QEMU has no native HDA controller; audio hardware behavior is not validated here.
QEMU has no target Intel WLAN device; Wi-Fi hardware behavior is not validated here.
QEMU xHCI validation is unavailable in this run.
Embedded media file open path was reached.
Framebuffer test pattern reached the render stage.

roles.agent-aether: Repository-native bounded process; reports through state, logs, commits and clock ticks.
roles.user-external: Human observer/interactor and source of external/runtime evidence.

channels.github_issues_discussions: durable requests, decisions and acceptance criteria
channels.qemu_serial: runtime observations from the reproducible lab
